title.en: Spell checking in your document's language

body.en: Lattice reads the document language from babel or polyglossia. Other languages get spell checking with a dictionary downloaded on first use; English keeps spelling and grammar checks. Thanks to @quark67.
body.zh: Lattice 会从 babel 或 polyglossia 读取文档语言。其他语言首次使用时会下载词典并检查拼写；英文仍同时检查拼写和语法。感谢 @quark67。

body.en: IEEE conference, IEEE journal and ACM (acmart).
body.zh: 新增 IEEE 会议、IEEE 期刊和 ACM（acmart）模板。

title.zh: 实验性 Windows 安装包

body.en: Each release now includes an unsigned Windows x64 installer. It is experimental; read docs/windows-installer.md in the Lattice repository before installing. Thanks to @LucasDavidTPE.
body.zh: 每个版本现在都附带未签名的 Windows x64 安装包。该安装包仍处于实验阶段，安装前请先阅读 Lattice 仓库中的 docs/windows-installer.md。感谢 @LucasDavidTPE。

fixes.en: "Install missing package" no longer gives up when several TeX Live packages provide the same file (such as IEEEtran.cls); Lattice lets you choose which one to install.
fixes.zh: 多个 TeX Live 包提供同一文件（如 IEEEtran.cls）时，“安装缺失的包”不再直接放弃，而是让你选择要安装的包。

fixes.en: Lower idle CPU use: no always-running animations, Overleaf checks pause while the window is hidden, and continuous file writes trigger fewer full project rescans.
fixes.zh: 降低空闲时的 CPU 占用：不再有持续运行的动画，窗口隐藏时暂停 Overleaf 检查，连续写入文件时减少整个项目的重新扫描。

fixes.en: About Lattice and the Help menu link to the GitHub repository and the website. Thanks to @quark67.
fixes.zh: “关于 Lattice”和帮助菜单中加入了 GitHub 仓库和官网的链接。感谢 @quark67。

fixes.en: On Windows, the Overleaf sign-in window no longer opens blank. Thanks to @ivanvykopal.
fixes.zh: 在 Windows 上，Overleaf 登录窗口不再显示空白。感谢 @ivanvykopal。
